profiles.role: Minimal receive surface of NFTStakerDepletion depended on by the two migrators. Analogue of IStableStaker but for an ERC1155 position (no (R,P) haircut - exact amounts move).
profiles.trustBoundary: permissioned fns gated onlyMigrator on the concrete NFTStakerDepletion; interface itself carries no logic.

profiles.type: interface (in-scope dependency, not in the 8 but read for import resolution)
profiles.role: Local re-declaration of ERC1155Supply.totalSupply(uint256) + NFTMinterV2.configs(uint256) so NFTStaker avoids reaching into yield-claim-nft implementation. configs returns (dispatcher, price=NEXT mint price, growthBasisPoints, disabled).

Deploys + configures a fresh BatchNFTMinter: pins TOKEN_MINTER, dispatcherIndex, nudge (USDC/size 40), pauser. On-chain cutover (SYA.setNudgeAddress, BalancerPoolerV2.setBatchMinter, Pauser.register) intentionally left to operator.

verifiedProperties.broadcastGuards: require: TOKEN_MINTER!=0, USDC!=TOKEN_MINTER, NUDGE_SIZE!=0, DISPATCHER_INDEX!=0, pauser!=0, owner!=0

localFindings.description: DISPATCHER_INDEX = 4 is ASSUMED (NatSpec says operator MUST confirm dispatcherToIndex(BalancerPoolerV2)/configs(4).dispatcher before broadcast). No on-chain assertion that index 4 actually resolves to the BalancerPoolerV2 dispatcher; a stale/wrong index would pin the wrong dispatcher (payment token then derived from the wrong dispatcher's primeToken()).
localFindings.recommendation: operator verifies index against live minter pre-broadcast (already documented); consider adding an on-chain configs(4).dispatcher == expected assert.

localFindings.description: Comment on line 70-72 references a require that 'nudge token must never equal payment token' but the actual on-chain enforcement of nudge!=primeToken lives in BatchNFTMinter.batchMint (up-front revert), not in this script. Script only checks USDC!=TOKEN_MINTER. USDS(prime)!=USDC is assumed, not asserted here.
localFindings.recommendation: acceptable - batchMint enforces at call time; note for completeness.

localFindings.description: Owner defaults to broadcasting msg.sender; if OWNER env unset in a multisig context the deploying EOA becomes owner. Operator checklist item, documented.

trustAssumptions: operator performs the documented out-of-band cutover steps
